metadata.description: AI CPO skills for founders, built for TOPY.AI: a chief product officer that decides what to build and proves it worked — feedback triaged with clear accept/reject rules, de-identified user research, a PMF survey, RICE priorities, a now/next/later roadmap, PRDs with a success metric, a build-or-not check before the AI CTO, pre-registered experiments read without peeking, and a decision log with falsifiers — on the TOPY CPO MCP server (https://topy.ai/mcp/cpo); standalone skills are product methods that work anywhere.
